misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen record linking forecast specifications and issuance/evidence-cutoff times to eligible matured outcomes could make prior forecast performance auditable. The supplied evidence does not establish that it would have changed any decision or prevented a demonstrated miss.
misses.decision_reference: research/framework_memory/existing_evidence_gap_registry.items.EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES and EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE: forecast specifications, issuance times, and eligible evidence cutoffs are reported missing.
misses.decision_relevance: Without the original forecast and its information cutoff, target-time settlement prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or demonstrate a decision failure.
misses.miss_description: Data gap only: the supplied settlement records confirm target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but the registry says they are not linked to prior forecast specifications, issuance times, or eligible evidence cutoffs. No decision failure is demonstrated.
misses.missing_history_problem: Immutable forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent. Settlement capture times are adjudication target times, not source-observation or decision times.
misses.outcome_reference: FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36 and EXP-FC-fda5190d000dbc293f4e, provide confirmed target-time prices; the registry states they are not linked to available prior forecast specifications.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
